extraction.name: VAP-Data
extraction.description: A semantic-controlled paired video dataset for unified semantic-controlled video generation, with over 100K curated paired samples across 100 semantic conditions covering concept, style, motion, and camera categories.
extraction.creator: Yuxuan Bian, Xin Chen, Zenan Li, Tiancheng Zhi, Shen Sang, Linjie Luo, Qiang Xu
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was bootstrapped by curating high-quality reference images from the Internet and generating paired videos using commercial image-to-video visual-effects templates and community LoRAs, matching each image to compatible templates.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: 2K high-quality reference images from the Internet, plus visual-effects templates from commercial models (VIDU and Kling) and community LoRAs used to generate paired videos.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Paired videos were created by matching each curated reference image to all compatible semantic templates; the dataset was reorganized into four primary categories and evaluation subsets were evenly sampled from the test split.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The authors curated high-quality reference images before generating paired videos.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Semantic labels/conditions come from the applied visual-effects templates and LoRA definitions; for evaluation, semantic alignment was automatically scored by submitting each reference-generation pair with semantic-specific evaluation rules to Gemini-2.5-pro.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: The semantic-alignment scoring procedure used a general template plus semantic-specific criteria, and its stability was validated by repeating the evaluation with GPT-5 and comparing trends to human preference rates.
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: 20 randomly selected video-generation researchers participated in the user study.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The paper states that any artifact release will be accompanied by a research-only license and an acceptable-use policy (AUP) that explicitly prohibits abusive or unlawful scenarios. No versioning timeframe, maintainers, update schedule, or deprecation policy are specified.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Human-related subject categories including men, women, children, and gender-related transformation semantics such as gender swap.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The paper discusses misuse risks including identity impersonation, deepfake content, targeted harassment, deceptive political messaging, and sexualized or violent media, and states the system is intended only for research, education, and creative prototyping, not high-risk uses such as surveillance or political persuasion.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: Because the dataset is synthetic and derived from commercial models and community LoRAs, it may inherit stylistic biases, artifacts, and conceptual limitations from those source templates and models.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The semantic conditions are relatively limited, synthetic, and derived from other generative models; the dataset may inherit source-model artifacts and conceptual limitations. Performance also depends on caption quality and subject structural similarity, and multi-reference prompting can blend unwanted visual details.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is intended to support research on unified semantic-controlled video generation, including training and evaluation/benchmarking across concept, style, motion, and camera control, as well as zero-shot generalization and downstream applications.

name.evidence: We introduce VAP-Data, the largest to date, with over 100 K curated samples across 100 semantic conditions, providing a robust data foundation for unified semantic-controlled video generation.
